_comment: The game's vocabulary. A card names a mechanic; this explains it ONCE, in the card inspector. Before this file every card re-taught its own rules on the face, which is why card text kept growing (design/feel-and-readability.md). Keywords are DERIVED from a card's fields by GameHost._keywords_of — no card has to declare them, so a new card gets the right tooltips for free.

timed.name: Timed
timed.text: Play it on the sweeping bar. Land in the bright zone for the bonus — miss and the card slips away with no effect at all.

poison.name: Poison
poison.text: The beast bleeds this much at the start of each of its turns. It does not wear off.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: Each stack makes one incoming hit deal 4 more. Stacks are spent as they are used — and they bank while you are below the weak point.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.text: Goes up by 1 every time you land a timed card this turn. Resets at the end of your turn, so Rhythm cards want to be chained in one go.

strength.name: Strength
strength.text: Adds to every attack you play for the rest of the fight.

block.name: Block
block.text: Absorbs damage before your health. It clears at the start of your next turn, so it is worth spending, not saving.

height.name: Height
height.text: How far up the beast you have climbed. The weak point sits at the top — see Armoured.

armoured.name: Armoured
armoured.text: Below the weak point the hide takes only a quarter of your damage, and Expose stacks bank instead of being spent. Climb to the sigil before you commit a big hit.

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: A live timer that drains whenever you are between holds. Reach a ledge or the sigil before it empties or you fall to the base.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.text: The beast targets you this round instead of your ally.

burn.name: Burn
burn.text: The card is removed for the rest of this fight. Some Goblin cards get stronger for every card burned.

enchant.name: Enchanted
enchant.text: A named effect attached to this one card. What it does is printed on the card itself.

keywords._comment_moves: Below: the beast's telegraphed moves. Same vocabulary rules as the cards — the intent tag NAMES the move and prints its number, and the explanation lives here, one right-click away. Ids match the move `type` in bosses.json. Added 2026-08-16: the tag had started explaining itself inline ('Sweep 8 — hits you both'), which is the card-text problem all over again.

attack.name: Attack
attack.text: A single hunter, the one the beast is turned toward. Your Block comes off it first.

attack_all.name: Sweep
attack_all.text: Hits BOTH hunters for the full amount, and shakes each of you down to the hold below. Block on one of you does nothing for the other.

swipe_high.name: Lash the flank
swipe_high.text: Only catches hunters off the ground. Standing at the base is the safe place to be this round.

swipe_low.name: Stamp
swipe_low.text: Only catches hunters still on the ground. Anyone already climbing is above it.

leech.name: Drain
leech.text: Hits the hunter it is turned toward, and the beast heals for what it takes.

rift.name: Wrench apart
rift.text: Hits both hunters, and gets worse the further apart you are — 2 more damage for every Height between you. Climb together and it is just the base number.

block.name: Defend
block.text: The beast guards. Damage comes off its Block before its health, and the Block is gone by its next turn.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.text: Permanently raises every attack it makes for the rest of the fight. A soft timer: the longer the fight runs, the harder it hits.

regen.name: Recover
regen.text: The beast heals. Damage you have already dealt is not lost, but the clock just moved against you.

shift_sigil.name: Shift its sigil
shift_sigil.text: The weak point moves to a new Height, and any damage banked into the old one is lost. Whatever you climbed may now be the wrong place.
